subject: Error with estimator="WLSMV" and large data set

messages.author: ee65f9feb643484e
messages.subject: Error with estimator="WLSMV" and large data set
parts:
Dear lavaan group,

I'm getting an error when trying to use WLSMV and ordered variables in a large data set. I'm using lavaan 0.5-17. An example is shown below.

set.seed(1)
n <- 200000

d <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(n))
d$x2 <- 0.8*d$x1 + rnorm(n)
d$x3 <- 0.8*d$x1 + rnorm(n)
d$x4 <- 0.8*d$x1 + rnorm(n)

d$x3 <- ifelse(d$x3 > 0, 1, 0)
d$x4 <- ifelse(d$x4 > 0.3, 1, 0)

mod1 <- 'F =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4'

sem(model = mod1, data = d, estimator="ML")   # No error
sem(model = mod1, data = d, estimator="MLR")   # No error
sem(model = mod1, data = d, ordered=c("x3", "x4"), estimator="WLSMV")   # Error shown below

Error in if (freq[1, 1] * freq[2, 2] == freq[1, 2] * freq[2, 1]) { : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In freq[1, 1] * freq[2, 2] : NAs produced by integer overflow

There is no error if n is 100000 instead of 200000.

I would appreciate any advice on how to get around this.

Thanks,
Mark

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error with estimator="WLSMV" and large data set
parts:
On 11/28/2014 02:57 AM, Mark Seeto wrote:
> Error in if (freq[1, 1] * freq[2, 2] == freq[1, 2] * freq[2, 1]) { :
> missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
> In addition: Warning message:
> In freq[1, 1] * freq[2, 2] : NAs produced by integer overflow

Ah, good catch. Freq contains the number of observations per cell ... as
integers. Multiplying two large integers quickly results in integer
overflow. Changing the storage.mode to numeric seems to fix this.

Now fixed in dev 0.5-18.749

Yves.

parts:

Thanks for providing such great software.

Mark
